name: growth.market.arbitrage
description: Scan the healthcare market for glitches, arbitrages, and under-priced attention. Identify where competitors are slow, where advertising is cheap, and where value disconnects exist.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Scan for market glitches (competitor bottlenecks)
steps.prompt: As a healthcare market analyst, identify 5 'glitches' (inefficiencies) in the current telehealth market where DoctaRx can dominate. For each: describe the bottleneck, why competitors are slow, how DoctaRx bypasses it, and estimated advantage in time/cost. Think: credentialing speed, insurance processing, patient matching.

steps.name: Scan for value arbitrages (buy cheap, sell valuable)
steps.prompt: Identify 5 'arbitrage' opportunities in healthcare/telehealth. Where can DoctaRx acquire resources (talent, advertising, technology) cheaply and apply them where they're highly valued? Consider: global talent pools, underpriced ad keywords, emerging platforms. For each: input cost, output value, margin estimate.

steps.name: Scan for under-priced attention (cheap high-converting channels)
steps.prompt: Find 5 under-priced attention sources for a telehealth startup. Think: new social platforms, niche communities, podcast sponsorships, healthcare forums. For each: platform/channel, estimated CPM, audience quality score (1-10), conversion potential. Focus on where the attention is cheap NOW but valuable.
